# Strata SYCL engine (serve/server.py config, 2x Arc Pro B70, expert parallel, 2 server slots; this run used 1 stream)
STRATA_BATCH_MTP=1 STRATA_BATCH_MTP_DEPTH=2 STRATA_BATCH_MTP_PAIR_HEAD=1 STRATA_NIGHT_MMVQ=1 STRATA_NIGHT_IQ=1 STRATA_NIGHT_HC=q8 STRATA_NIGHT_SH_LATE=1 STRATA_NIGHT_ATTN_BATCH=1 STRATA_NIGHT_SHEXP=1 STRATA_NIGHT_BF16=1 (+ more night flags) \
strata --native Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_XXS-00001-of-00002.gguf --ple-gguf Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_XXS-00002-of-00002.gguf --expert-parallel-device 1 --stream-experts --expert-cache auto --kv int8 --max-context 200000 --prefill 12288 --spec 4 --mtp <mtp-bf16> --mtp-max-t 4 --spec-min-p 0 --mtp-draft-vocab draft_vocab_en.bin --conversation-cache-mib 32768 --conversation-cache-slots 4

notes: Two Intel Arc Pro B70 (32 GB each, Xe2, kernel 7.1, Compute Runtime 26.22), Strata SYCL port with expert parallelism (card 1 runs half the experts) and MTP drafting (up to 4 tokens per window). Engine = upstream Strata 296b59d2 plus the unmerged expert-parallel PRs and local SYCL kernel patches (night-20261016 branch, default-off flags turned on). Greedy decoding, thinking on (reasoning tokens counted as output), 512 max tokens, 1 warmup + 3 timed iterations, median. Measured on the live office server (no other request during the window, checked by the token counter). lmx v0.1.54 has no --canonical-prompt, so the run used a small client with the same method that also records Strata's own per-request timings (engineTimingsRaw, draft_n/draft_n_accepted). Strata picks the draft length per window (at most 4): this run proposed 609 drafts over 204 verify windows (2.99 per window), so the fixed-width check (accepted + drafts/4) undercounts the emitted tokens; the counts are the engine's own.

prompt:
Implement a small command-line tool in Python called `logtally`.

Requirements:
- It reads newline-delimited JSON log records from stdin. Each record has `ts` (ISO-8601 string), `level` (one of DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), `service` (string), and optional `latency_ms` (number).
- It prints, per service, the count of records by level and the p50 and p95 of `latency_ms` (ignore records without latency).
- Malformed lines must be counted and reported at the end, never crash the program.
- Support a `--since <ISO timestamp>` flag that drops earlier records.
- Use only the standard library.

After the code, explain in two or three sentences how you computed percentiles and why you chose that method, then list three edge cases a unit test suite should cover.
